```{r}
# Current data through API
dir_create("Data_pedestrians/raw2")

raw_path <- "Data_pedestrians/raw2/pedestrian_counts_raw.csv"

pedestrian_url <- paste0(
  "https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/",
  "api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/",
  "pedestrian-counting-system-monthly-counts-per-hour/",
  "exports/csv?delimiter=%2C&with_bom=false"
)

request(pedestrian_url) |>
  req_perform(path = raw_path)


current <- read_csv(
  here(
    "Data_pedestrians",
    "raw2",
    "pedestrian_counts_raw.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  clean_names()

current_clean <- current |>
  transmute(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count = pedestriancount,
    source = "Current API"
  )

```

```{r}
# Historical data
historical <- read_csv(
  here(
    "ETC5543-Pulse_of_Melbourne",
    "Data_pedestrians",
    "raw",
    "Pedestrian_Counting_System_Monthly_counts_per_hour_may_2009_to_14_dec_2022.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  clean_names()

# Historical data standarise
historical_clean <- historical |>
  mutate(
    sensing_date = mdy(
      str_c(month, mdate, year, sep = " ")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    sensor_id,
    sensing_date
  ) |>
  arrange(
    id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hour_repaired =
      n() == 24 & n_distinct(time) == 1,

    hourday = if_else(
      hour_repaired,
      row_number() - 1,
      time
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    location_id = sensor_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count = hourly_counts,
    hour_repaired,
    source = "Historical"
  )

```

```{r}
# Combine
pedestrian_full <- bind_rows(
  historical_clean,
  current_clean
) |>
  arrange(
    sensing_date,
    location_id,
    hourday
  )
```

```{r}
pedestrian_full <- pedestrian_full |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(sensing_date),
    month = lubridate::month(sensing_date),

    month_name = lubridate::month(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    ),

    day_name = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE,
      week_start = 1
    ),

    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      week_start = 1
    ),

    is_weekend = day_of_week >= 6,

    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# Check for missing values
pedestrian_full |>
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    locations = n_distinct(location_id),
    first_date = min(sensing_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(sensing_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_dates = sum(is.na(sensing_date)),
    missing_hours = sum(is.na(hourday)),
    missing_counts = sum(is.na(pedestrian_count))
  )

pedestrian_full |>
  summarise(
    negative_counts = sum(pedestrian_count < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    invalid_hours = sum(
      hourday < 0 | hourday > 23,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

# Check for duplicates
duplicates <- pedestrian_full |>
  count(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    name = "n"
  ) |>
  filter(n > 1)

duplicates
```

-   A small number of historical sensor-day groups contained 24 distinct hourly count observations but duplicated timestamps; where the record ordering clearly preserved the hourly sequence, hour labels were reconstructed from record order, with repaired observations flagged.

-   Recieved this data on 29/09/2026 from data operations manager at city of melbourne on personal mail.

```{r}
# Snapshot data
snapshot_dir <- here::here(
  "Data_pedestrians",
  "raw",
  "data_pedestrian"
)

snapshot_files <- list.files(
  snapshot_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

snapshot_files

# Inspect snapshot file structure 
snapshot_schema <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    x <- data.table::fread(
      file = f,
      nrows = 5
    )
    
    tibble::tibble(
      file = basename(f),
      n_columns = ncol(x),
      columns = paste(names(x), collapse = " | ")
    )
  }
)

snapshot_schema

# Check snapshot data coverage
snapshot_coverage <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    x <- data.table::fread(
      file = f,
      select = c(
        "Location_ID",
        "Sensing_Date",
        "HourDay",
        "PedestrianCount"
      )
    )
    
    data.frame(
      file = basename(f),
      first_date = min(as.Date(x$Sensing_Date)),
      last_date = max(as.Date(x$Sensing_Date)),
      days = data.table::uniqueN(x$Sensing_Date),
      sensors = data.table::uniqueN(x$Location_ID),
      observations = nrow(x),
      hours = data.table::uniqueN(x$HourDay)
    )
  }
)

snapshot_coverage

# Check daily coverage
snapshot_daily_coverage <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    x <- data.table::fread(
      file = f,
      select = c("Sensing_Date")
    )
    
    dates <- as.Date(x$Sensing_Date)
    
    data.frame(
      file = basename(f),
      days_observed = data.table::uniqueN(dates),
      expected_days = ifelse(
        lubridate::leap_year(min(dates)),
        366,
        365
      ),
      missing_days = ifelse(
        lubridate::leap_year(min(dates)),
        366,
        365
      ) - data.table::uniqueN(dates)
    )
  }
)

snapshot_daily_coverage

# Check for duplicates
snapshot_duplicates <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    x <- data.table::fread(
      file = f,
      select = c(
        "Location_ID",
        "Sensing_Date",
        "HourDay"
      )
    )
    
    dup <- x[
      ,
      .N,
      by = .(Location_ID, Sensing_Date, HourDay)
    ][N > 1]
    
    data.frame(
      file = basename(f),
      duplicate_groups = nrow(dup),
      duplicated_rows = sum(dup$N - 1)
    )
  }
)

snapshot_duplicates
```

```{r}
# 2022 snapshot data
# Validate snapshot data
snapshot_2022 <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(snapshot_dir, "2022_Pedestrian_Data.csv"),
  select = c(
    "Location_ID",
    "Sensing_Date",
    "HourDay",
    "PedestrianCount"
  )
)

historical_2022 <- pedestrian_full %>%
  filter(year == 2022) %>%
  select(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count
  )

# Comparing the snapshot data with the above pedestrian_full data
comparison_2022 <- snapshot_2022 %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Sensing_Date = as.Date(Sensing_Date)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    historical_2022,
    by = c(
      "Location_ID" = "location_id",
      "Sensing_Date" = "sensing_date",
      "HourDay" = "hourday"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    count_difference = PedestrianCount - pedestrian_count
  )

summary(comparison_2022$count_difference)

# Summary difference 
comparison_2022 %>%
  summarise(
    matched_rows = n(),
    different_rows = sum(count_difference != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_difference = max(abs(count_difference), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Examine different records
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(count_difference != 0) %>%
  summarise(
    different_rows = n(),
    mean_difference = mean(count_difference),
    median_difference = median(count_difference),
    mean_absolute_difference = mean(abs(count_difference)),
    median_absolute_difference = median(abs(count_difference)),
    max_absolute_difference = max(abs(count_difference))
  )

# Examine differences by month
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(count_difference != 0) %>%
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::floor_date(Sensing_Date, "month")
  ) %>%
  count(month, sort = TRUE)

# Examine differences by sensors
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(count_difference != 0) %>%
  count(Location_ID, sort = TRUE)

# Inspect largest differences 
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(count_difference != 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(count_difference))) %>%
  select(
    Location_ID,
    Sensing_Date,
    HourDay,
    PedestrianCount,
    pedestrian_count,
    count_difference
  ) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
# Investigate location 6
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(Location_ID == 6, count_difference != 0) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_difference = mean(count_difference),
    median_difference = median(count_difference),
    min_difference = min(count_difference),
    max_difference = max(count_difference)
  )

# Location 6 differences by month
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(Location_ID == 6, count_difference != 0) %>%
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::floor_date(Sensing_Date, "month")
  ) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    different_records = n(),
    mean_difference = mean(count_difference),
    median_difference = median(count_difference),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Direction of differences
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(Location_ID == 6, count_difference != 0) %>%
  count(
    direction = case_when(
      count_difference > 0 ~ "Snapshot higher",
      count_difference < 0 ~ "Snapshot lower",
      TRUE ~ "Same"
    )
  )

# Validate directions total
comparison_2022 %>%
  filter(Location_ID == 6, count_difference != 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(count_difference))) %>%
  select(
    Location_ID,
    Sensing_Date,
    HourDay,
    PedestrianCount,
    pedestrian_count,
    count_difference
  ) %>%
  head(20)
```

## Standardisation and Integration

### Standardise Snapshot Data

```{r}
snapshot_standardised <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    
    x <- data.table::fread(file = f) %>%
      as_tibble()
    
    x %>%
      transmute(
        location_id = as.numeric(Location_ID),
        sensing_date = as.Date(Sensing_Date),
        hourday = as.numeric(HourDay),
        pedestrian_count = as.numeric(PedestrianCount),
        hour_repaired = FALSE,
        source = paste0("city_snapshot_", substr(basename(f), 1, 4))
      )
  }
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(sensing_date),
    month = lubridate::month(sensing_date),
    month_name = lubridate::month(sensing_date, label = TRUE),
    day_name = lubridate::wday(sensing_date, label = TRUE),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(sensing_date, week_start = 1),
    is_weekend = day_of_week >= 6,
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    )
  )
```


### Replace 2022–2025 with Validated Snapshots

```{r}


## Rebuild final pedestrian dataset

### Keep historical data before 2022

historical_data <- pedestrian_full %>%
  filter(!year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>%
  select(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count,
    source,
    any_of("hour_repaired")
  )

# If the historical dataset does not contain hour_repaired,
# create it as FALSE.
if (!"hour_repaired" %in% names(historical_data)) {
  historical_data$hour_repaired <- FALSE
}


### Prepare validated 2022–2025 snapshots

snapshot_data <- snapshot_standardised %>%
  select(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count,
    source
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hour_repaired = FALSE
  )


### Combine historical and validated data

pedestrian_full_updated <- bind_rows(
  historical_data,
  snapshot_data
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(sensing_date),

    month = lubridate::month(sensing_date),

    month_name = lubridate::month(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    ),

    day_name = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    ),

    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      week_start = 1
    ),

    is_weekend = day_of_week >= 6,

    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    location_id
)

```

## Daily and Weekly Pedestrian Rhythm

### Hourly Pedestrian Activity Over Time

```{r}
hourly_by_sensor_year <- pedestrian_full %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(hourday),
    hourday >= 0,
    hourday <= 23
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, location_id, hourday) %>%
  summarise(
    sensor_hour_avg = mean(pedestrian_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hourly_by_year <- hourly_by_sensor_year %>%
  group_by(year, hourday) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_pedestrians = mean(sensor_hour_avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hourly_index <- hourly_by_year %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    yearly_mean = mean(avg_pedestrians, na.rm = TRUE),
    activity_index = avg_pedestrians / yearly_mean * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

hourly_summary <- hourly_index %>%
  group_by(hourday) %>%
  summarise(
    median_index = median(activity_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(activity_index, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(activity_index, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
daily_interactive_data <- hourly_index %>%
  mutate(
    year_label = case_when(
      year == 2009 ~ "2009 (partial)",
      year == 2026 ~ "2026 (partial)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(year)
    )
  )
```

### PLOT 1 — Typical Daily Pedestrian Rhythm

```{r}

daily_interactive <- plot_ly(
  daily_interactive_data,
  x = ~hourday,
  y = ~activity_index,
  color = ~year_label,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines",
  text = ~paste0(
    "Year: ", year_label,
    "<br>Hour: ", hourday, ":00",
    "<br>Activity index: ", round(activity_index, 1)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Daily Pedestrian Rhythm by Year",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of day",
      tickmode = "linear",
      tick0 = 0,
      dtick = 1
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Activity index (100 = yearly average)"
    ),
    hovermode = "closest",
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Year"),
      orientation = "v",
      x = 1.02,
      y = 1
    ),
    margin = list(r = 150)
  )

daily_interactive
```

## Monthly Pedestrian Rhythm

```{r}
# Monthly rhythm using the full available dataset: 2009–2026
monthly_profile <- pedestrian_full |>
  filter(
    year >= 2009,
    year <= 2026
  ) |>
  group_by(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    month,
    month_name
  ) |>
  summarise(
    daily_count = sum(
      pedestrian_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(
    location_id,
    month,
    month_name
  ) |>
  summarise(
    sensor_month_mean = mean(
      daily_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(
```

```{r}
seasonal_profile <- pedestrian_full |>
  
  # Step 1: Daily total for each sensor
  group_by(
    location_id,
    year,
    sensing_date,
    season
  ) |>
  summarise(
    daily_count = sum(
      pedestrian_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  # Step 2: Typical activity for each sensor in each season/year
  group_by(
    location_id,
    year,
    season
  ) |>
  summarise(
    sensor_season_mean = mean(
      daily_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  # Step 3: Typical city activity within each year and season
  group_by(
    year,
    season
  ) |>
  summarise(
    yearly_season_mean = mean(
      sensor_season_mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  # Step 4: Average seasonal pattern across all available years
  group_by(season) |>
  summarise(
    mean_daily_count = mean(
      yearly_season_mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    season = fct_relevel(
      season,
      "Summer",
      "Autumn",
      "Winter",
      "Spring"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
sensor_daily_events <- pedestrian_full |>
  filter(
    !is.na(pedestrian_count)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    location_id,
    sensing_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    daily_count = sum(
      pedestrian_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    hours_observed = n_distinct(hourday),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(
    hours_observed >= 20
  ) |>
  mutate(
  day_of_week = lubridate::wday(
    sensing_date,
    week_start = 1
  ),

  day_name = lubridate::wday(
    sensing_date,
    label = TRUE,
    abbr = FALSE,
    week_start = 1
  )
)
```

```{r}
sensor_event_index <- sensor_daily_events |>
  arrange(
    location_id,
    day_of_week,
    sensing_date
  ) |>
  group_by(
    location_id,
    day_of_week
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expected_count = slide_dbl(
      daily_count,
      ~ median(
        .x[-5],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .before = 4,
      .after = 4,
      .complete = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    uplift_percent =
      100 *
      (daily_count - expected_count) /
      expected_count
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(uplift_percent)
  )
```

```{r}
event_day_summary <- sensor_event_index |>
  group_by(sensing_date) |>
  summarise(
    median_uplift = median(
      uplift_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    sensors_reporting = n_distinct(location_id),
    
    sensors_above_20 = sum(
      uplift_percent >= 20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    proportion_above_20 = mean(
      uplift_percent >= 20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    median_daily_count = median(
      daily_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
event_candidates_episode <- strong_event_candidates_non_covid |>
  arrange(sensing_date) |>
  mutate(
    gap_days = as.numeric(
      sensing_date - lag(sensing_date)

    new_episode = is.na(gap_days) | gap_days > 1,
    episode_id = cumsum(new_episode)
  )
```

```{r}
event_episode_candidates <- event_candidates_episode |>

    flagged_days = n(),

      which.max(median_uplift)

    peak_uplift = max(
      median_uplift,
      na.rm = TRUE

    max_proportion_above_20 = max(
      proportion_above_20,
      na.rm = TRUE
```

```{r}


decrease_day_summary <- sensor_event_index %>%
  group_by(
    sensing_date

  summarise(
    median_decrease = median(
      uplift_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sensors_reporting = n_distinct(
      location_id
    ),

    sensors_below_20 = sum(
      uplift_percent <= -20,
      na.rm = TRUE

    proportion_below_20 = mean(
      uplift_percent <= -20,
      na.rm = TRUE

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
event_permits |>
```

```{r}
# Cleaning the inconsistency in the events dataset
event_permits_relevant <- event_permits |>
  mutate(
    category_1_clean = category_1 |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_squish() |>
      str_replace_all(
        "non\\s*-?\\s*ticketed",
        "non-ticketed"
      ) |>
      str_replace_all(
        "run\\s*/?\\s*walk",
        "run/walk"
      ),

    event_type = case_when(

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "non-ticketed"
        ) ~
        "Non-ticketed public event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "ticketed"
        ) ~
        "Ticketed public event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "run/walk"
        ) ~
        "Run/Walk",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "music"
        ) ~
        "Music event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "cycling"
        ) ~
        "Cycling event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "parade"
        ) ~
        "Parade",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "memorial"
        ) ~
        "Memorial",

      category_1_clean == "public event" ~
        "Other public event",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(event_type)
  )
```


```{r}
event_permits_qc <- event_permits_relevant |>
  mutate(
    duration_days =
      as.numeric(event_end - event_start) + 1,

    permit_match_class = case_when(
      is.na(event_end) ~
        "Missing end date",

      duration_days <= 7 ~
        "Suitable for automatic matching",

      duration_days <= 30 ~
        "Extended permit - inspect manually",

      duration_days > 30 ~
        "Long permit window - do not auto-match"
    )
  )

event_permits_qc |>
  count(
    permit_match_class,
    sort = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
event_permits_auto <- event_permits_qc |>

      "Suitable for automatic matching"

  filter(
    permit_match_class !=
      "Suitable for automatic matching"
  )
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    peak_date_inside_event =
      peak_date >= event_start &

    desc(peak_date_inside_event)
  )
```

```{r}

holiday_calendar_official <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("Data_pedestrians", "raw2", "important_dates_august_2026.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(dateType == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY") %>%
  transmute(
    holiday_date = lubridate::dmy(important_date),
    holiday = name,
    publisher,
    source
  ) %>%
  filter(
    holiday_date >= as.Date("2019-01-01"),
    holiday_date <= as.Date("2026-09-06")
  ) %>%
  distinct(holiday_date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(holiday_date)

holiday_calendar_official %>%
  count(lubridate::year(holiday_date), name = "holidays")
```

```{r}

decrease_holiday_test <- decrease_non_covid %>%
  filter(
    lubridate::year(sensing_date) %in%
      c(2019, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    holiday_calendar_official %>%
      select(holiday_date, holiday),
    by = c("sensing_date" = "holiday_date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    holiday_status = if_else(
      is.na(holiday),
      "Normal day",
      "Public holiday"

decrease_holiday_test %>%
```

## Weather and Pedestrian Activity Analysis

```{r}

weather_daily <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("Data_pedestrians", "raw2", "melbourne_weather_daily.csv"),
  skip = 3,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    sensing_date = as.Date(time),

    max_temperature_c = `temperature_2m_max (°C)`,

    min_temperature_c = `temperature_2m_min (°C)`,

    max_wind_kmh = `wind_speed_10m_max (km/h)`,

    rainfall_mm = `precipitation_sum (mm)`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sensing_date >= as.Date("2009-05-01"),
    sensing_date <= as.Date("2026-09-06")
  )

weather_daily %>%
  summarise(
    total_days = n(),
    first_date = min(sensing_date),
    last_date = max(sensing_date),
    missing_rainfall = sum(is.na(rainfall_mm)),
    duplicate_dates = n() - n_distinct(sensing_date)
  )
```

### Combine Weather with Pedestrian Decreases

```{r}

weather_dip_daily <- decrease_day_summary %>%
  filter(
    sensors_reporting >= 10,
    lubridate::year(sensing_date) %in%
      c(2019, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    weather_daily,
    by = "sensing_date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    significant_dip =
      median_decrease <= -20 &
      proportion_below_20 >= 0.30,

    public_holiday =
      sensing_date %in%
      holiday_calendar_official$holiday_date
  )

weather_dip_daily %>%
  summarise(
    total_days = n(),
    significant_dip_days = sum(significant_dip),
    public_holiday_days = sum(public_holiday),
    holiday_dip_days = sum(significant_dip & public_holiday),
    missing_weather = sum(is.na(rainfall_mm)),
    duplicate_dates = n() - n_distinct(sensing_date)
  )
```

```{r}
recent_data <- pedestrian_full |>
  filter(
    year %in% 2023:2025,
    between(hourday, 0, 23),
    !is.na(pedestrian_count),
    pedestrian_count >= 0
  )

# Identify sufficiently complete days
valid_days <- recent_data |>
  group_by(location_id, year, sensing_date) |>
  summarise(
    hours_observed = n_distinct(hourday),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(hours_observed >= 23)

# Check coverage in each year
recent_coverage <- valid_days |>
  group_by(location_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    days_observed = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expected_days = if_else(leap_year(year), 366, 365),
    coverage = days_observed / expected_days
  )

# Retain sensors with good coverage in all 3 years
reliable_sensors <- recent_coverage |>
  group_by(location_id) |>
  summarise(
    years_covered = n_distinct(year),
    minimum_coverage = min(coverage),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(
    years_covered == 3,
    minimum_coverage >= 0.80
  )

reliable_sensors |>
  summarise(sensors_selected = n())
```

```{r}
hourly_profiles <- recent_data |>
  semi_join(
    valid_days,
    by = c("location_id", "year", "sensing_date")
  ) |>
  semi_join(
    reliable_sensors,
    by = "location_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    day_type = if_else(
      lubridate::wday(sensing_date, week_start = 1) <= 5,
      "Weekday",
      "Weekend"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(location_id, day_type, hourday) |>
  summarise(
    typical_count = median(pedestrian_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(location_id) |>
  filter(
    n() == 48,
    sum(typical_count) > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hour_share = typical_count / sum(typical_count)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# One row per sensor, with 48 profile measurements
cluster_features <- hourly_profiles |>
  mutate(
    feature = paste0(
      day_type,
      "_",
      str_pad(hourday, width = 2, pad = "0")
    )
  ) |>
  select(location_id, feature, hour_share) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = feature,
    values_from = hour_share
  ) |>
  drop_na()

# Calculate distances between sensor profiles
sensor_distances <- cluster_features |>
  select(-location_id) |>
  stats::dist()

set.seed(123)

# Test 2 to 5 clusters
cluster_tests <- tibble(k = 2:5) |>
  mutate(
    model = map(
      k,
      ~ stats::kmeans(
        cluster_features |> select(-location_id),
        centers = .x,
        nstart = 30
      )
    ),
    silhouette = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ mean(
        cluster::silhouette(
          .x$cluster,
          sensor_distances
        )[, "sil_width"]
      )
    )
  )

cluster_tests |>
  select(k, silhouette)
```

```{r}

best_k <- cluster_tests |>
  slice_max(
    silhouette,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  pull(k)

set.seed(123)

final_kmeans <- stats::kmeans(
  cluster_features |> select(-location_id),
  centers = best_k,
  nstart = 50
)

sensor_clusters <- cluster_features |>
  select(location_id) |>
  mutate(
    cluster = paste0(
      "Cluster ",
      final_kmeans$cluster
    )
  )

sensor_clusters |>
  count(cluster)
```

```{r}
cluster_profiles <- hourly_profiles |>
  inner_join(
    sensor_clusters,
    by = "location_id"
  ) |>
  group_by(cluster, day_type, hourday) |>

cluster_profiles |>
```

### Load Sensor Location Information

```{r}
# Create one location record per sensor

sensor_lookup <- sensor_locations %>%
  group_by(Location_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    sensor_name = first(SensorVariable),
    latitude = first(Latitude),
    longitude = first(Longitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(location_id = Location_ID)

```


```{r}
sensor_overall_dips <- sensor_event_index %>%
  filter(
    sensing_date >= as.Date("2023-01-01"),
    sensing_date <= as.Date("2025-12-31"),
    !is.na(uplift_percent),
    is.finite(uplift_percent)
  ) %>%
  group_by(location_id) %>%
  summarise(
    days_reporting = n_distinct(sensing_date),

    dip_days = sum(uplift_percent <= -20),

    dip_rate_pct = round(
      100 * mean(uplift_percent <= -20), 1
    ),

    median_dip_pct = round(
      median(
        uplift_percent[uplift_percent <= -20],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ), 1
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(days_reporting >= 180) %>%
  left_join(sensor_lookup, by = "location_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(dip_rate_pct))

print(
  sensor_overall_dips %>%
    select(
      location_id,
      sensor_name,
      days_reporting,
      dip_days,
      dip_rate_pct,
      median_dip_pct
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 15),
  n = 15,
  width = Inf
)
```

```{r}
#| label: sensor-dip-map

sensor_dip_map_ready <- sensor_overall_dips %>%

# Create colour scale

  palette = "YlOrRd",

)

# Interactive map

  data = sensor_dip_map_ready
) %>%
  leaflet::addTiles() %>%
  leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,

    fillColor = ~sensor_palette(dip_rate_pct),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0(
      sensor_name,
      " | Dip rate: ", dip_rate_pct, "%"
    ),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Sensor: </b>", sensor_name,
      "<br><b>Location ID: </b>", location_id,
      "<br><b>Reporting days: </b>", days_reporting,
      "<br><b>Dip days: </b>", dip_days,
      "<br><b>Dip rate: </b>", dip_rate_pct, "%",
      "<br><b>Median dip: </b>", median_dip_pct, "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = sensor_palette,
    values = ~dip_rate_pct,
    title = "Dip rate (%)",
    opacity = 0.8
  )

sensor_dip_map

```
